html:
SMTO-SCH-0022 — The Agent needs you to say exactly when

GUID: 6df91364-033d-4e0e-9272-fd89ddd96f7b
Slug: temporal-request-needs-clarification
Domain: SCH · Subsystem: sch

What happened

  • Your message mentioned a time that could mean more than one thing, so SMTO stopped the Agent from doing or scheduling anything until you say exactly when. That step did not run.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look in the conversation for the Agent's question about timing and answer it, for example "Friday, March 6 at 3:00 PM Pacific time". SMTO won't act on the request until the time can only mean one thing.
  2. If the run stopped without a question, send a new message that repeats the request with the exact date, time and time zone. Words like "later" or "next week" don't give SMTO a single time to use.
  3. Afterwards, open Schedules and check that the schedule shows the time you meant. This confirms the Agent used your answer and not a guess.

What success looks like

  • The Agent continues, and the schedule (if one was needed) appears on the Schedules page with the right Next run.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep sending the same unclear wording; add the exact date and time first.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Temporal routing is waiting for a timing clarification and blocked a proposed action other than ask_user.

What this means

  • Temporal routing is in needs_temporal_clarification and the proposed action is not the supported ask_user clarification route. Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.

Why this can happen

  • Temporal routing is in needs_temporal_clarification and the proposed action is not the supported ask_user clarification route.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the captured clarification question before choosing a wake time or schedule.

How to fix it

  • native/temporal_routing.guard is in phase needs_temporal_clarification and only allows ask_user; the clarification_question is returned to the model as the correction. Answer the pending question in the same task so routing can resolve the timing before any scheduling or deferred work proceeds.
  • Answer the pending timing clarification using the existing task interaction before scheduling or executing deferred work.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The supported user response establishes unambiguous intended timing.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Schedule configuration and temporal checks do not themselves launch deferred work. Existing event/request identities, captured authority and original execution receipts remain authoritative; diagnostic rendering does not poll time or mutate scheduling state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
